title: Shopify
description: Edit your store's SEO, manage theme copies and publish blog posts.

notConnected.title: Connect your Shopify store
notConnected.description: Connect the store in Settings → Integrations to see its traffic, edit SEO and publish blog posts.

connection.title: Shopify
connection.description: Connect this project's store through the Shopify Admin API. MericSEO reads analytics and edits products, pages, blog posts, files and theme copies.
connection.shopDomainHint: Your myshopify.com address, for example my-store.myshopify.com.
connection.modeClientHint: From the app you created in the Shopify Dev Dashboard and installed on this store. MericSEO renews the token automatically.
connection.modeTokenHint: An Admin API access token (starts with shpat_) from a custom app.
connection.scopesHint: Give the app these scopes so every feature works:
connection.missingScopes: Some scopes are missing, so some features won't work: {{scopes}}
connection.disconnectDescription: MericSEO deletes the stored credentials. Nothing changes in your store.
connection.noPermission: Only organization admins can change this connection.

dashboard.title: Shopify store
dashboard.analyticsUnavailable: Shopify didn't return analytics. Make sure the app has the read_reports scope.
dashboard.loadError: Couldn't load Shopify data. Try again shortly.

themes.intro: Code changes always go into a copy of your live theme. Each copy is named with its version and a short summary of the work. Preview it, then publish it whenever you're ready.
themes.publishDescription: This copy becomes your live theme right away. The current live theme stays in your theme library, so you can publish it back.
themes.summaryHint: Short description of the change, shown in the theme name. For example: header speed fix.
themes.claudeHint: Ask Claude to make Liquid or CSS changes. It edits only MericSEO copies, never the live theme.

publish.title: Publish to Shopify
publish.description: Creates the blog post in your store, uploads its images to Shopify Files and sets the SEO title and meta description.
publish.noBlogs: This store has no blog yet. Create one in Shopify under Online Store → Blog posts.
